data.name: Hollywood Horror Story: The Black Dahlia Funeral Limo Tour
data.headline: A three-hour immersive limo tour tracing Elizabeth Short’s final days and key Los Angeles locations connected to the Black Dahlia case.
data.description: Step into a noir‑tinged memorial as you ride in a vintage funeral limo through Hollywood and South Los Angeles, following the last known footsteps of Elizabeth Short. The guide layers archival research, atmospheric storytelling, visuals, and a curated soundtrack to examine the woman behind the Black Dahlia myth—her residences, haunts, medical history, suspects, and the discovery site of her body. This immersive three‑hour tour blends true‑crime investigation, cultural history, and evocative scenes of postwar Los Angeles to reframe a notorious cold case.
data.highlights:
* Ride in a vintage funeral limo for an immersive, atmospheric experience
* Visit the actual streets, hotels, and buildings tied to the Black Dahlia case
* Archival visuals, curated soundtrack, and researched storytelling
* Expert guide reframes myth and focuses on Elizabeth Short’s humanity
data.itinerary:
1. Chancellor Apartments - Outside view of Room 501 and discussion of Short’s life there.
2. Pig'n'Whistle - Sidewalk stop to place Short in Hollywood’s café scene.
3. Boardners - Outside visit and stories of its noir-era patrons.
4. Hollywood Cherokee building - Stop outside the gynecologist’s former office and related background.
5. Hollywood Blvd - Funeral limo drive along Hollywood Boulevard with narrative of the area.
6. The Frolic Room - Sidewalk stop examining its connection to Dahlia-era nightlife.
7. Florentine Gardens - Stop discussing suspect connections and alleged encounters.
8. Guardian Arms - Outside stop covering a short stay tied to suspect Margolis.
9. Sowden (Hodel) House - Street-level viewing and discussion of allegations against Hodel.
10. Biltmore Hotel - Stop covering the last known sightings and conflicting accounts.
11. The Crown Bar - Near former nightclub site and its role in timelines.
12. Hotel Cecil - Outside stop linking the hotel to broader true crime legends.
13. Herald Examiner Building - Discussion of media sensationalism and leaked details.
14. Catalina St bungalow - Stop covering theories tying the bungalow to the murder.
15. Coffee and restroom break
16. Walter Bayley residence - Stop about another suspect’s former home.
17. Body discovery location - Site visit to the lot where Short’s body was found.
18. Store on Crenshaw - Stop where personal items were reportedly found.
19. AHS Murder (Rosenheim) House - Outside view and discussion of pop‑culture links.

data.booking_notes:
It is the sad duty of Grave Line Tours to announce the tragic passing of Ms. Elizabeth Short. A private memorial service will be held inside of a beautifully melancholic restored vintage Cadillac funeral limousine. Tissues will be on hand in case of bouts of severe sadness.  

The service commences strictly on schedule. 
Once more, the service starts on time. 
Therefore, please keep in mind that the service starts on schedule, as the dead wait for no one.

Loved ones, acquaintances and mourners shall gather at the Ovation Center, 6801 Hollywood Blvd, Los Angeles 90028 at Hollywood and Highland. If you park in Ovation, take the elevator to level 2. If you’re walking in from Hollywood Blvd, please ascend the unnaturally wide steps opposite the El Capitan Theater. Or, from Highland, up the staircase near the light at Yucca.  Once in the level 2 courtyard, look for your guide on the side of the “Pandora” store, by the entry to the grand courtyard.

For more information and photos of the meeting point, kindly please visit https://graveline.rip/pages/tour-info. 

There is ample parking in the dark labyrinth known as a “garage” underneath the Ovation Hollywood center. For information on directions and parking rates, please inspect their site directly. Grave Line Tours does not validate as of now, but there are several frighteningly wondrous shops, theaters and eateries you may find yourself looking to donate to before or after your ride, in the name of the departed and cheaper parking. Please do not bring food or drink (apart from bottled water, holy is fine too) into the vehicle. 

A mortuary associate will be present at the meeting point to welcome your presence twenty minutes prior to taking your seats in the service.  We strongly advise you to allow PLENTY of time to find parking and make the journey from there up to the meeting point. Los Angeles is big and traffic can be really bad here, and— like all tragic occurences, is almost always worse than you even plan for.  

Therefore we urge you as strongly as mortally possible to arrive at the MEETING POINT (not parking structure) 15-20 MINUTES **before** your service is set to depart. It is unfortunately impossible to disrupt the service with a call once the tour has begun.  (Texting us to let us know you're running late does not change anything.) So please, lovely Grave Line mourner, be forewarned: there is simply no way to join the memorial service other than on time at the initial congregating spot.  

Look for a friendly woman! In the event you do not find your guide to the service, please call Simone at (424) 452-0980. International mourners can Whatsapp her at (424) 452-0980.

Did we mention you will need to allow PLENTY of time because of Los Angeles traffic and unforeseen circumstances?  Heed our Warning, and don’t miss your chance to bid farewell to souls departed!

In lieu of flowers please bring your fondest memories of the decedent to share. Thank you.
data.check_in_details: Meet at Ovation Hollywood (6801 Hollywood Blvd). A mortuary associate will welcome guests 20 minutes before seating; arrive at the meeting point 15–20 minutes before departure. Late arrivals cannot join once the tour begins.
data.accessibility: Vehicles are older limousines and may not meet modern accessibility standards; limited space for mobility devices.
data.special_requirements: Tour contains explicit and potentially disturbing content; not recommended for children under 12. Minors under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian.
data.restrictions: No luggage or strollers allowed (vehicles accommodate passengers only). No eating, smoking, or drinking on tours (bottled water with caps permitted). Pets and infants under 5 are strictly prohibited.
data.health_and_safety_notes:
Tours are not for all audiences! 

Content is often extreme and graphic in nature and every passenger will have access to explicit photos of crime scenes and autopsies. 

Parental guidance is highly recommended for passengers under the age of 18.
data.disclaimers: Tours may be canceled for low bookings. Tours operate in most weather unless safety is at risk and will depart on schedule; late arrivals are not refunded or rescheduled. Food and drink (except capped bottled water) are prohibited. Some tour content is explicit and graphic; attendees under 18 must have parental permission. Vehicles are older limousines and may have wear‑related issues; the operator is not liable for most damages or delays beyond its control. If a vehicle breakdown occurs, the operator will return passengers to the departure point and issue a full refund of ticket cost only. Passenger size/weight constraints may require rescheduling or refunds for some guests. Disruptive riders may be removed without refund.
